identity_rule: A title search result cannot be joined automatically. The selected video must be the preregistered official artist/label release or receive an explicit documentary identity audit. Lyrics, audio uploads, remixes, Shorts, fan videos and duplicate regional uploads remain separate artifacts.

outcomes.construct: cumulative public YouTube circulation at a documented observation time
outcomes.operational_definition: Public view count for one verified canonical video at captured_at.
outcomes.provider: vidIQ get-videos-by-id or YouTube search result resolved by video_id
outcomes.measurement_error: Platform validation and revisions, unavailable private traffic, duplicate releases and capture-time variation.

outcomes.operational_definition: Natural log of one plus observed views divided by complete days since publication, retained with the raw numerator, denominator and capture timestamp.
outcomes.measurement_error: Lifetime average obscures bursts, paid campaigns, recommendation shocks and changes in platform scale.

outcomes.construct: maximum observed YouTube view velocity within the registered observation window
outcomes.operational_definition: Maximum non-missing vidIQ VPH observation in a preregistered hourly or daily time series, with peak timestamp and window retained.
outcomes.measurement_error: Sampling granularity, missing intervals, provider coverage, external promotion, news events and recommendation-system shocks.
forbidden_interpretations: causal effect of a musical feature

outcomes.construct: section-local audience retention contrast at chorus intervals
outcomes.operational_definition: Mean audienceWatchRatio over independently timestamped chorus intervals minus the mean over preregistered adjacent comparison intervals, using elapsedVideoTimeRatio on the same video duration.
outcomes.unit: chorus occurrence within an authorized video
outcomes.provider: YouTube Analytics through vidIQ channel_analytics audience_retention
outcomes.measurement_error: Section-boundary error, video/song edit mismatch, repeated viewing, audience composition and unavailable analytics for channels without authorization.

outcomes.construct: corpus-local thematic similarity among cases classified by a preregistered circulation rule
outcomes.operational_definition: Difference in mean pairwise similarity of admissible lyric-theme representations between the preregistered high-traffic set and matched comparison sets, evaluated by a registered permutation procedure.
outcomes.provider: HookLab admissible lyric-theme features plus an admissible circulation outcome
outcomes.measurement_error: Theme coding/model error, language effects, threshold instability, artist clustering and unequal genre/year composition.
forbidden_interpretations: popular songs share one universal topic

clock_separation.content_clock: Elapsed seconds or elapsedVideoTimeRatio within the audiovisual artifact
clock_separation.rule: Publication-time peaks cannot be assigned to a chorus. Chorus claims require content-clock audience-retention data aligned with independently measured section boundaries.
